_note: Standalone single-mode manifest config. sk-media-editor is a normal skill (no mode-registry.json). Its leaves are the MEDIA framework, operation references, tools catalogue and router contract in references/, the HLS asset in assets/ and the playbook scenarios. changelog/ is release history, not a routable leaf, and the system-level benchmark/ sits outside the skill root, so both stay outside leafRoots. Consumed by generate-leaf-manifest.cjs to emit leaf-manifest.json. leaf-aliases.json is the derived identity projection of that manifest, so regenerate both together via ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs --fix.
